title: Peaceable Kingdom Jumbo Butterfly Floor Puzzle 53 Pieces – Large Jigsaw Puzzle Gift for Toddlers and Kids Ages 5+ – Shimmery Butterfly
features: TOYS THAT TEACH: Kids learn visual recognition and develop fine-motor and problem-solving skills as they assemble the large, easy-to-handle pieces of Peaceable Kingdom's shimmer foil floor puzzles.

UNIQUE DESIGN: This butterfly-shaped floor puzzle is made of thick, sturdy pieces with shiny foil accents. Puzzle pieces are uniquely shaped for curious minds and include basic shapes like a circle, square, triangle and more.
CLASSROOM FUN: A great addition to any classroom. The box includes a corded handle for easy carrying. The large pieces make it a great group activity for reinforcing cooperation and cognitive skills.

HEART & SOUL: Peaceable Kingdom products inspire cooperation, kindness and caring with meaningful board games, toys, and activities. Build connections as you practice teamwork through imaginative play!
GIANT-SIZED: The large pieces are designed with young kids in mind. The completed puzzle measures over 3 feet long! INCLUDES: 53 foil-accented pieces. (Ages 5 and up)
